summary.text: Dick Werner is a Republican candidate for the South Dakota House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously represented District 22 in the House from 2013 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: Dick Werner won election to the South Dakota House of Representatives from District 22 and served from 2013 to 2017.

In the 2013-2014 session he served on the Appropriations and Joint Appropriations committees, and at the start of the 2015 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Natural Resources and Transportation committees.
He ran for re-election in District 23 in 2016 and was defeated in the Republican primary by John Lake and Spencer Gosch.
